Core Active Vocabulary (10 items):

cut — to divide food with a knife. Example: Cut the potatoes.
cook — to prepare food with heat. Example: Cook for twenty minutes.
mix — to put things together. Example: Mix everything together.
boil — to heat water until it bubbles. Example: Boil the water.
bake — to cook in an oven. Example: Bake the bread for thirty minutes.
add — to put something more into a dish. Example: Add salt and pepper.
recipe — the instructions for cooking a dish. Example: This is a simple recipe.
salt — a white substance that gives taste. Example: Add a little salt.
pepper — a black spice for food. Example: Add pepper at the end.
oil — a liquid fat used for cooking. Example: Don't add too much oil.
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• First, cut the ...
• Then boil the water.
• Add salt and pepper.
• Mix everything.
• Cook for twenty minutes.
